integratedmanager.configuration.title: Integrated Manager Configuration
integratedmanager.configuration.debug.to:
Options related to debugging and development.
These are mostly useful for debugging graph flow issues.
integratedmanager.configuration.debug.sh: This will show the velocities of nodes in the network.
This will show all edges in the network, even those that are not relevant for Integrated Dynamics networks.
integratedmanager.configuration.debug.se: This will settle the graph, which means it will run the graph until it is stable.
integratedmanager.configuration.debug.au:
Automatically advance the graph.
If disabled, you will have to manually advance the graph with the Play button in the GUI.
integratedmanager.configuration.debug.se:
The number of steps to take when settling the graph initially.
This is only used if 'settleGraph' is enabled.

The number of optional steps to take when settling the graph.
This is only used if 'settleGraph' is enabled.
integratedmanager.configuration.clientgr: Client-side options related to the visualization of networks.

Show variable stores in the graph.
This is not very useful and might just clutter the graph.

This will connect the nodes with cables in the graph.
These connections are not representative of the actual cables in the world, but rather a visual aid to see how nodes are connected.
